messages.text: Parker seems plausible with the 9-mm handgun and Oslo presence. What evidence supports Parker over Nelson?
Parker and Nelson both appear to have been in Oslo, but Parker is the one linked to the matching 9-mm handgun. Nelson has motive evidence, but so far I have no evidence tying her to a firearm.
